Nexa 1.0

The first release of Nexa: a private messenger for the Mac with no accounts, no phone numbers and no servers of ours.

  • End-to-end encrypted chats, with post-quantum protection and keys that change with every message
  • Group chats for up to 10 people
  • Encrypted files up to 25 MB
  • Built-in Tor, with bridges for networks that block it
  • Disappearing messages, app lock with Touch ID, and encrypted backups
